Ashby | YC 19 | REMOTE | Hiring Senior/Staff Product Engineers (Americas) | $178k–$299k
Ashby is the all-in-one recruiting platform powering hiring at the world's most innovative companies. If you cmd+f "Ashby" you'll see that we're powering many of the job postings in this thread!
As we scale our platform, we are also looking to scale our Product Engineering team.
Why Join?
High Seniority & Density: 80%+ of our engineering team is Senior–Staff+ level. You’ll be working alongside peers who excel at navigating ambiguity and setting high standards.
True End-to-End Ownership: We give an unusual amount of autonomy. You’ll own features from initial spec writing and customer interviews all the way to production. Many of our most loved features were built entirely by a single engineer!
Product Sense > Pure Speed: Building fast is getting easier, but building the right thing still isn't. Customer empathy, sound judgment, and product taste matter far more to us than where you worked in the past.
100% Remote Async Culture: Low meeting overhead, high trust, and an even distribution of engineers across North America and Europe.
Here's how we're thinking about AI at Ashby: 
https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/engineering/ai-ashby-engineerin...
More about our engineering culture:
https://nextplayso.substack.com/p/should-you-join-ashby
Full transparency on engineering levels + comp: 
https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/engineering/leveling-and-compen...
Stack: TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, Redis.
Full list of open roles: https://www.ashbyhq.com/careers?utm_source=HNwhoshiring

CyberAtlas | https://cyberatlas.ai | Software Engineer | REMOTE Worldwide | Full-time
CyberAtlas maps the internet to help security teams, enterprises, and governments discover and understand their exposed digital infrastructure.
We’re hiring a Software Engineer to build internet-scale systems processing billions of domains and websites.
You’ll work on backend services, data pipelines, search, fingerprinting, vulnerability detection, malware detection, and performance optimization.
Looking for strong Python (Flask/FastAPI) and/or Go experience, large-scale data systems, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Redis/LMDB, MongoDB/Postgres, Docker, and production systems.
How to apply:
Email atlas@cyberatlas.ai with your CV and, as a simple anti-bot check, include:
1. The query you ran on Finder (https://cyberatlas.ai/finder)
2. The first-page results returned by that query
3. Please include “HN Software Engineer” in the subject.
